text.en:
1. Jalan Tawau-Semporna (Laluan 1)

U 4.425724, T 118.183222 (jarak sepanjang 5.053 km).
text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Sekatan Berat

(Jalan Persekutuan) (Pindaan) (No. 3) 2026.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 12 Jun 2026.

Pindaan Jadual Kedua

text.en:
2. Jalan Kinabatangan-Sandakan (Laluan 1)

U 5.755267, T 117.753988 (jarak sepanjang 19.905 km).
text.ms:

dalam Senarai I Jadual Kedua, dengan memasukkan selepas kepala Negeri Sarawak dan

butiran yang berhubungan dengannya kepala dan butiran yang berikut:

"NEGERI SABAH

text.en:

 DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

 Menteri Kerja Raya

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

WEIGHT RESTRICTIONS (FEDERAL ROADS) (AMENDMENT) (NO. 3) ORDER 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 70(1) of the

Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Weight Restrictions (Federal Roads)

(Amendment) (No. 3) Order 2026.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 12 June 2026.

Amendment of Second Schedule

2. The Weight Restrictions (Federal Roads) Order 1989 [P.U. (A) 478/1989] is

amended in List I of the Second Schedule, by inserting after the heading of

State of Sarawak and items relating to it the following heading and items:

"STATE OF SABAH

1. Tawau-Semporna Road (Route 1)

Starting at coordinates N 4.398709, E 118.159266 and ending at

coordinates N 4.425724, E 118.183222 (a distance of 5.053 km).

2. Kinabatangan-Sandakan Road (Route 1)

Starting at coordinates N 5.643293, E 117.828885 and ending at

coordinates N 5.755267, E 117.753988 (a distance of 19.905 km).

3. Putatan-Penampang Road (Route 1)

Starting at coordinates N 5.888399, E 116.0755 and ending at coordinates

N 5.890635, E 116.080663 (a distance of 0.628 km).

4. Penampang-Kota Kinabalu Road (Route 1)

Starting at coordinates N 5.939292, E 116.136605 and ending at

coordinates N 5.9815, E 116.160557 (a distance of 5.672 km).".

Made 11 June 2026

[KKR.PUU.110-1/6/16 Jld.2; PN(PU2)460/JLD.142]

 DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

 Minister of Works
